top_stories.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live to take on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 at a fraction of the cost
top_stories.description: Google Deepmind released Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, two new audio models for developers that top the Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech leaderboard. At $1.38 per hour of voice conversation, Google significantly undercuts OpenAI's GPT-Live-1, which should still sound more natural thanks to full duplex. The article Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live to take on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 at a fraction of the cost appeared first on The Decoder.

top_stories.title: Russian team ‘misused’ Claude AI to train a killer drone on scraped Ukrainian war footage
top_stories.description: Visual footage — even that created by journalists and civilians to document conflict and hold nations accountable — can now become raw material for weapons development.

top_stories.title: AI can now control fusion plasma faster than humans can react
top_stories.description: Princeton researchers have tested an AI system that can monitor and control fusion plasma in milliseconds, reacting far faster than a human operator. In one experiment, it predicted a damaging instability about 200 milliseconds before it appeared and adjusted the plasma to stop it from forming.

top_stories.title: Deploying Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod with vLLM
top_stories.description: Learn how to deploy Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, a 2.4-trillion-parameter open-weight model, on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod with vLLM. This walkthrough covers cluster provisioning, NVFP4 quantization, and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with built-in reasoning, tool calling, and native MTP speculative decoding.
